replacement.title: Automatic Replies to Comments and Likes
replacement.definition: Automatically send appropriate replies to supported social-media comments and likes.

patches.decision_note: Automatic replies to comments and likes are independently requested and can be configured and tested separately from keyword-triggered responses.

replacement.title: Complete PDF Response Content
replacement.definition: Ensure a PDF delivered through an automation displays its required content completely rather than being truncated.

patches.decision_note: The PDF truncation observation concerns an independently testable content-completeness behavior and should not be routed to keyword detection or resource mapping.
The source supplies the label 'home loan estimate'; shortening it to 'loan_estimate' is not supported by the supplied evidence.
The mapping should preserve the client-supplied label 'refinancing' rather than infer a different trigger spelling.
The source does not establish the normalized label 'mortgage_insurance'; the supplied label must be preserved unless other evidence resolves the apparent typo.
Review whether C2 Financial requires its own active automation configuration or is intentionally left in draft because the businesses share social pages.

The opening scope mentions direct-message replies while message 1 requests replies to comments and likes; available evidence cannot safely determine whether direct-message automation is an additional Requirement.
